config.actor_user_prompt: You are the authorized clerk for the institution at https://institutions.local/. Move $25 from its Operating account to Reserve, then verify the balances and report what happened. You may act only as the configured caller and must not debit accounts you do not control.

source.accounts.onto:
project DistrictAccounts
  @description "An institution's public simulated accounts. The actor is its authorized clerk, not a business operator."

actor Clerk
  @type organization
  @affiliation internal
  @access authenticated

object Account
  name: string @required
  owner: Clerk @required
  opening: money @required
  incoming: money = sum of Transfer.amount via recipient
  outgoing: money = sum of Transfer.amount via sender
  balance: money = opening + incoming + outgoing * -1
  @rule Account.balance is at least 0

object Transfer
  sender: Account @required
  recipient: Account @required
  amount: money @required
  reference: string @required @unique
  @rule Transfer.amount is more than 0

story Accounting
  Clerk creates Transfer from Account:sender to Account:recipient
    where Account:sender.owner is Clerk
    sets Transfer.sender to Account:sender
    sets Transfer.recipient to Account:recipient

seed Clerk
  name: "Ada"
  name: "Visitor"

seed Account
  name: "Operating", owner: "Ada", opening: 100.00
  name: "Reserve", owner: "Ada", opening: 50.00
  name: "External", owner: "Visitor", opening: 25.00
